flags.message: The sole frozen distribution (September 2 for the September 28 conference) appears to concern sealing motion 26M17, granted October 5, before October 7 petition docketing; the petition response is due November 6. Retained the supplied count=1 and baseline band, but did not interpret this as cert consideration. P(further distribution)=0.96 largely forecasts ordinary first distribution of the petition from this frozen count. Please review distribution/moment attribution to collateral motions. The sealing-motion grant was not treated as the petition outcome.

The 47-page petition is marked empty_text=true and its provisioned text is unusable; no QP or BIO text was provisioned. Opening the exact petition PDF through the web tool returned no readable content. Forecast completed from the snapshot, committed base rates, and the pre-petition September 30, 2025 D.C. Circuit opinion retrieved through MCP; exact petition framing and opposition arguments remain unassessed.
